promptSnapshot: Photorealistic botanical reference image of one mature flowering cannabis plant representing Gorilla Glue 4 S1, complete plant visible, neutral natural light, realistic botany. Do not assert cultivar-specific architecture, branching pattern, internode spacing, leaf width, flower shape, flower density, coloration, or resin/trichome intensity beyond ordinary natural cannabis morphology because the official cultivar page does not provide verified morphology evidence. No labels, logos, packaging, people, smoke, consumption context, text, or invented signature coloration.

evidenceSnapshot.description: Humboldt CSI's official Gorilla Glue 4 S1 page confirms cultivar identity and S1/selfed parentage but provides no verified cultivar-wide architecture, branching, internode, leaf-width, flower-density, color, or resin morphology descriptors. The generation prompt therefore intentionally avoids cultivar-specific morphology claims.
